techniques.title: Course IT Style 1
useWhen: This approved IT teaching style is selected for a course explanation or troubleshooting diagram.
preserve: Persistent technical objects, causal state changes, navy/cream/cyan art direction, readable holds and narration-led reveals.
adapt: Replace topic, objects, geometry, labels, source-backed claims and timing using the new lesson's narration.
avoidWhen: The brief requires a different style, real footage as proof or an ordinary vlog; do not force this look onto every video.

limits: User approved the USB sample's visual style on 2026-10-12. The saved kit is an editable SVG/HTML + GSAP authoring example, not a universal generator or automatic renderer adapter.

Narration and private footage are excluded. Adapt topic, geometry and real cues in a new project; fresh checks and preview review are required. Portrait, overlays, camera compositing and Remotion are not verified.
